interpretation_notes: Nationwide OPS-defined care cohort includes TIA and ophthalmic ischemia, not all stroke admissions.
Exposure is any R13 secondary diagnosis; comparator is not clinical absence of dysphagia.
J69.0 includes aspiration pneumonitis as well as pneumonia.
Exact multi-code unions used; summing code rows is invalid.
DRG-stratified LOS is descriptive; no causal savings.
The nationwide delivery is not a random sample; intervals use independent-episode models.
No private ChatGPT Page was created; final delivery is local manuscript for root to persist.
